description.value:
You concentrate gravitational force around your body, pulling nearby creatures violently toward you. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC. On a failure, the creature is also pulled up to 10 feet toward you (stopping if it would enter your space or be blocked by a solid obstruction); this forced movement does not trigger reactions. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled 20 feet toward you instead.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage but is not pulled.

Failure The creature takes full damage (2d6 bludgeoning) and is pulled up to 10 feet toward you.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage (4d6 bludgeoning) and is pulled up to 20 feet toward you.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
